high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Thangalaan." The poster features a dramatic scene with a central figure who appears to be a warrior or a hero, standing shirtless amidst a group of people. The individual has long hair and a beard, and their expression conveys intensity and determination. The background is filled with smoke or mist, adding to the dramatic atmosphere. The text on the poster includes: "TRAILER 10TH JULY" at the top, indicating the release date of the trailer. "CHIYAAN VIKRAM" below the title, identifying the lead actor.
